extractions.value: Needle EMG and surface EMG. Surface EMG recorded continuous simultaneous co-contraction of agonist and antagonist muscles at rest, bilaterally synchronized periodic myoclonic jerks, and spreading patterns descending from facial muscles or ascending from leg muscles. Myoclonic jerks were triggered by sudden sound or touch. Surface EMG also explored the inhibitory effect of dexmedetomidine on hyperexcitability to the jaw jerk reflex maneuver.
